## Description {#details}

This header defines the internal components and auxiliary structures employed by the µTest++ testing framework. The contents of this file are not intended to constitute part of the public API and may be altered without prior notice.

It provides implementation specifics such as assertion handling, generic getter utilities, comparator structures for various logical and relational operations, as well as mechanisms for exception checking. Additionally, it includes base classes for deferred reporting of test results.

All definitions reside within the <code><Link to="/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail">micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus::detail</Link></code> namespace to prevent pollution of the public API and to maintain a clear distinction between user-facing and internal components. This approach enhances maintainability and minimises the risk of naming conflicts.

This file is intended solely for internal use within the framework and should not be included directly by user code.

## Functions

### get() {#ac627271520bf2fe8a4c4774bcd9bf343}

<MemberDefinition
  template={<>template &lt;class T&gt;</>}
  prototype={<>auto micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus::detail::get (const T &amp; t)</>}
  labels = {["nodiscard", "constexpr"]}>
Generic getter function template for value retrieval.

The <code>get</code> function template invokes the appropriate getter implementation to retrieve the value from the provided object or type. This function ensures consistent access to values for both custom and standard types within the framework.

The primary implementation attempts to invoke a <code><Link to="/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/#ac627271520bf2fe8a4c4774bcd9bf343">get()</Link></code> method if it exists, which is recommended for user-defined types to ensure consistent value access. If the type does not provide a <code><Link to="/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/#ac627271520bf2fe8a4c4774bcd9bf343">get()</Link></code> method, the fallback variadic implementation simply returns the original argument.

The <code>get</code> function template delegates to these implementations, enabling seamless support for a wide range of types in test expressions and comparators.

All definitions are intended for internal use within the framework and are implemented in the <code>include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus</code> folder to maintain a structured and modular codebase.

Fallback variadic getter function template.

The <code>get&#95;impl</code> function template serves as a fallback mechanism for value retrieval when the provided type does not implement a <code><Link to="/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/#ac627271520bf2fe8a4c4774bcd9bf343">get()</Link></code> member function. It simply returns the first argument, discarding any additional parameters.

This approach ensures that both custom types (with a <code><Link to="/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/#ac627271520bf2fe8a4c4774bcd9bf343">get()</Link></code> method) and standard types (without a <code><Link to="/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/#ac627271520bf2fe8a4c4774bcd9bf343">get()</Link></code> method) are supported seamlessly within the framework&#39;s generic getter utilities.

All definitions are intended for internal use within the framework and are implemented in the <code>include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus</code> folder to maintain a structured and modular codebase.
